response.justification: The candidate substantially exceeds the 6+ years experience requirement with 15+ years of full-stack work, current hands-on experience in TypeScript/Node.js, direct AI-agent and MCP tooling experience, and a demonstrated testing-first engineering culture (TDD, authored test frameworks). Cloud (AWS CDK), Kubernetes, MongoDB, and Java are all covered. The main gaps are no explicit Nest.js, Vitest, or Kotlin experience, though these are likely quick ramps given the breadth shown.
strengths: Deep, current TypeScript/Node.js/React full-stack experience plus hands-on AI agent and MCP development
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, and authored open-source testing tools
Proven scalability experience (micro-services at millions of requests/sec) and cloud/container skills (AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js or Vitest experience mentioned, which are core to the primary stack
Kotlin and Python are absent from the skills list; Java experience appears dated
Significant time invested in niche technology (DLang) and side projects may signal ramp-up needed on the specific modern stack conventions
